THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Sub - section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. An allotment of land depicted in the Advanced Tracing No. KU/PLP/2022/1235 dated 31.10.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Madahapola (F.V.P. 409), in Grama Niladhari Division No. 409 Madahapola in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Polpithigama in, Kurunegala District, North Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Nikalandahenyaya - Extent: 0.4047 Hectare North and East: Nikalandahenyaya claimed by vernerable Shatrapathi Mangala Sthiweera; South: Nikalandahenyaya claimed by Vernerable Shatrapathi Mangala Sthiweera and
Attalayaya claimed by R.P. Gunasinghe; West: Attalaya claimed by R.P. Gunasinghe and Road (R.D.A.).
K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/8/2017/PC/224.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.8th January, 2025.
